name: What unique considerations apply to buying a luxury condo on Fisher Island?

mainEntity.name: What unique considerations apply to buying a luxury condo on Fisher Island?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buying a luxury condo on Fisher Island involves unique considerations beyond typical South Florida properties. It's a private, guard-gated island accessible only by ferry or private yacht, which impacts logistics, guest access, and overall lifestyle. Properties here command premium prices due to extreme exclusivity and unparalleled amenities, including a private beach, golf course, and multiple dining options. Buyers should factor in the very high HOA fees, which reflect these exclusive services, and understand the island's unique transportation and community rules before committing to a purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fisher Island luxury condos involve unique considerations like private ferry access, extreme exclusivity, unparalleled amenities, and very high HOA fees.
